MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub feels useful because I have bought USB adapters and a USB expansion card; connecting peripherals is a recurring practical need for me.",
    "The display cable and wired earbuds relate to my past cable and headset purchases, although that connection alone does not give me a reason to buy them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming sticks and smart speaker do not solve the computer connection needs reflected in my purchases, and I have no current reason to add them.",
    "My small-tablet mount does not imply I need another tablet or a TV wall mount; those purchases would serve different purposes.",
    "The memory card and hard drive case assume storage or carrying needs that I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat an interest in computer accessories as a reason to want electronics broadly, including entertainment devices.",
    "They extend a shared word or function, such as mounting or cables, beyond the particular device and task I was buying for."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of network adapters, USB expansion and connection cables suggest that practical connectivity matters more to me than adding new entertainment devices.",
    "I buy infrequently, so a related item needs a clear current use; a past headset or display cable purchase does not establish a replacement need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognize my interest in connectivity accessories but stretch it into broader electronics purchases without a clear current use."
}
